connector.name: Rival Regulatory Toolkit
connector.registryDescription: Read-only regulatory source retrieval, citation tracing, authority metadata, and recent filings.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package regulatory-toolkit. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rival-intelligence account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: RIVAL_API_KEY
env.description: Managed Rival API key. Required for production API access.

env.name: RIVAL_API_BASE_URL
env.description: Rival API base URL. Defaults to https://api.tryrival.ai.

env.name: RIVAL_FIXTURE_MODE
env.description: Set to true to run against the bundled sample corpus without API access.
